proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(reshape2))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(packageVersion("reshape2")), "1.4.5"))

n <- 20000L
month <- (seq_len(n) %% 12L) + 1L
variable <- LETTERS[(seq_len(n) %% 5L) + 1L]
value <- ((seq_len(n) * 13L) %% 97L) + (seq_len(n) %% 7L) / 10
df <- data.frame(month = month, variable = variable, value = value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

one <- function() dcast(df, month ~ variable, mean)

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}

cat("NAMES ", paste(names(value), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("MONTH ", paste(value$month, collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
for (nm in names(value)[-1]) {
  cat("COL ", nm, " ", paste(sprintf("%.17g", value[[nm]]), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
}
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from reshape2.dcast import dcast, mean

n = 20000
letters = [chr(ord("A") + k) for k in range(26)]
month = [(i % 12) + 1 for i in range(1, n + 1)]
variable = [letters[i % 5] for i in range(1, n + 1)]
value_column = [((i * 13) % 97) + (i % 7) / 10 for i in range(1, n + 1)]
frame = {"month": month, "variable": variable, "value": value_column}


def one():
    return dcast(frame, "month ~ variable", mean)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

names = [name for name, _column in value.columns]
print("NAMES " + " ".join(names))
print("MONTH " + " ".join(str(item) for item in value.columns[0][1].values))
for name, column in value.columns[1:]:
    print("COL " + name + " " + " ".join(format(item, ".17g") for item in column.values))
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
